title: 2025 Topps Series 1 Corey Seager Spring Training Parallel Texas Rangers #281
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2025 Topps Series 1 Corey Seager Spring Training Parallel trading card featuring the player from the Texas Rangers team. Made of card stock, this original sports trading card is part of the Major League Baseball league. The card showcases a unique Spring Training Foli parallel variety, making it a sought-after collectible for fans of baseball and collectors of trading cards. With no autograph, this standard-size card is a valuable addition to any sports memorabilia collection.
